title: Toasted Coconut, Lychee and Lime Granita
changes_from_base: Toasted coconut, canned lychees, coconut milk and lime replace the strawberry purée.
summary: A refreshing tropical ice treat combining fragrant toasted coconut with sweet lychee and zesty lime for a light, fluffy texture.

ingredients.item: can lychees in syrup (about 565 g), not drained
finely grated lime zest, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast 40 g desiccated coconut in a dry frying pan over medium-low heat for 4-5 min until golden. Keep it moving so it browns evenly and smells fragrant.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Put the toasted coconut, 565 g lychees with their syrup, 120 ml coconut milk, 120 ml coconut water, 100 g sugar, 60 ml lime juice and ¼ tsp salt into a blender. Process for 1 min until the mixture is completely smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour the liquid through a fine sieve into a 33 x 23 cm dish, using a spatula to press hard on the solids. Discard the pulp and stir 2 tsp lime zest into the strained liquid.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Place the dish uncovered in the freezer for about 1 h. Wait until the edges are frozen but the centre is still slushy.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Scrape the frozen edges with a fork and stir the ice crystals into the middle. Repeat this every hour for 3-4 h until the mixture is light and fluffy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Give the granita a final scrape with the fork to break up any large chunks. Spoon into chilled glasses and garnish with extra lime zest to serve.

tips: Use fresh lime zest for the brightest citrus aroma.
Ensure the coconut milk is well shaken before measuring.
Chill your serving glasses in the freezer beforehand to prevent the ice from melting too quickly.
storage: Keep the granita covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork to fluff the crystals before serving.
